title: Recovering constructibility at a finite boundary
statement:
Let $b:Y\to S$ be proper
between finite-type $k$-schemes, where $k$ is the field of the unit, with the finite coefficients of
[sbc-def-coefficient-conventions].
Let $a:G\hookrightarrow Y$ be open, with closed complement
$i:Z\hookrightarrow Y$, and assume $bi:Z\to S$ is finite.
For $K\in\hyperref[def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]{D^+(Y,\Lambda)}$,
suppose $a^*K$ and the direct image
$Rb_*K$ belong to their respective
bounded constructible categories.
Then $K\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$.

proof.text: Convert the finite-constant-value bounded constructibility predicate to the source-library boundedConstructible predicate, in both directions. In each degree use [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. A cohomology support interval [r,s] yields IsGE r and IsLE s by DerivedCategory.isGE_iff and isLE_iff. Conversely choose [min r s,max r s], which also covers empty or reversed support bounds. This is the local equivalence hiff in the Lean proof.

Package the coefficient hypothesis as HasInvertibleExponent. Convert the proper-image hypothesis by the preceding equivalence and transport it along the proved source-library natural isomorphism Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility, evaluated at K, from the bounded-below right derived direct image to the unbounded right derived direct image. Membership in the source boundedConstructible subcategory is invariant under isomorphisms.

Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.boundedConstructible_of_upperStar_of_rightDerivedLowerStar from the proved source module WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.FiniteBoundary. This is an existing realization of this very blueprint lemma, not a new assumed statement: its complete proof uses the open-closed triangle, extension by zero, proper pushforward, the derived pushforward compositor, finite reflection and the final triangle. The given S structure morphism supplies the field and finite-type assumptions, K.property supplies bounded-below cohomology, and the given complement and finiteness assumptions are unchanged. Convert its conclusion back using hiff. No unit statement or unit proof step is bypassed.
